high_contrast: Retain existing white background, black outlines, skin and clothing colours; no visible changes in this rollout.
exceptions: Retain selected person/body-region and action-bearing highlights.
Retain yellow expression-only Paper faces and semantic yellow objects.
Retain white eyes with pupils, teeth and meaningful mouth interiors.
Retain profession uniforms, medical white coats and contrasting participant colours.
Retain grey hair indicating age and highlighted hair when hair is the concept.
Retain symptom colours and colour-bearing objects.
Use dark marks on pale/yellow skin and white marks on dark blue skin.
A neutral shirt must not hide a movement or detail mark.
authoring: Edit semantic profile attributes in masters, regenerate exports, update catalogue hashes; inspect every visible change individually at 1024 and relevant small size. Do not blanket-recolour objects or animal anatomy.
